claims.text: The source defines latent diffusion: a perceptually-trained autoencoder (KL-regularised toward N(0,I) or VQ-regularised, decoder-side quantisation) compresses images once and is reused; diffusion runs on latents z with a time-conditional UNet; text/boxes/layout condition via domain encoder tau_theta(y) and cross-attention.

Reported numbers: 256px unconditional FID CelebA-HQ 5.11, FFHQ 4.98, Church 4.02, Bedroom 2.95 (LDM-4/8, 200 DDIM steps); COCO-256 FID 12.63, IS 30.29±0.42; DDIM 10-200 steps; guidance s=1.5-10 over 200-250 steps; convolution beyond 256px to ~1024px for SR/inpainting.

limitations.text: Pixel-level detail still limited by first stage; LDM-32 over-compression stagnates; sequential sampling still costly; misuse/bias noted.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
